channel.title: Wire — AI
channel.description: AI from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: AI;DR (AI; Didn't Read)
item.description: I'm about as pro-AI as you can be, but this is becoming a pet peeve of mine (and I'm not alone). That's why I love the AI;DR acronym as my new solution for ignoring the walls of slop. (2 sources: hackernews, lobsters)

item.title: Import AI 469: Science AI; RSI simulator; and Zuck’s technological pessimism
item.description: Welcome to Import AI, a newsletter about AI research. Import AI runs on arXiv, cappuccinos, and feedback from readers. If you’d like to support this, please subscribe. (1 source: importai)

item.title: How to disable or avoid intrusive AI
item.description: One of the biggest questions I get at Drop-In Time at the library (besides "what is taking up all my cloud storage?") is how to disable or avoid intrusive AI that shows up where people don't want it. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Why is GitHub so unreliable?
item.description: I don't really understand the problems. Git is notoriously hard to scale and not meant for these kinds of use cases, but they have figured it out by now, I guess. (1 source: rprogramming)

item.title: A practical workflow for LLM-assisted development
item.description: Dmitri's blog about programming, Clojure, and software development (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Netflix Open-Sources Agentic Workflow for Causal Inference
item.description: Netflix open-sourced an agentic workflow for Observational Causal Inference (OCI) that reduces toil in causal analysis. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Grab Cuts Mechanical Analytics Work From 44% to 30% with AI Agents
item.description: Grab is using AI agents to automate analytics workflows, cutting mechanical analyst work from 44% in February to 30% in June. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: SpaceXAI Launches Grok Bot for Autonomous AI Agents
item.description: SpaceXAI has introduced Grok Bot, a system of persistent AI agents that operate on dedicated cloud computers and can interact with websites, applications, inboxes, and other tools. By Daniel Dominguez (1 source: infoq)

item.title: AI-Generated GitHub Copilot “Autofix” Allowed Compromise of Snowflake's Jira
item.description: Wiz Red Agent finds its way into Snowflake's internal Jira through a flaw in a GitHub Copilot–Assisted PR. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Major Frontier Model Providers Adopt Watermarking Tech to Comply with EU Regulation
item.description: As of August 2, 2026, the EU AI Act Article 50 requires AI systems to mark synthetic outputs in a machine-detectable manner. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: We Tracked a Shipment of Rare Books. It Ended at an Amazon AI Training Facility
item.description: Excellent piece of reporting from 404 Media. For a while now there have been stories of book dealers receiving orders for large volumes of books from apparently price-insensitive anonymous customers, … (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Google buys crashed airline Spirit's data at auction, because AI
item.description: $10 million buys over 100 million emails, 30 million recorded phone calls, reams of stuff from Teams, Oracle, and SAP (1 source: hackernews)
